items.html: And if you should say: behold, ZA too is shorter in level than AVI even after the correction of his Partzuf, all the more so now, since just as AVI clothe the three middle [Sefirot] of Arich, so ZA clothes only the three lowest of Arich—so why did his six Nekudot need to be included and clothed three within three? But the reason is as explained above.
